name: aicommitsummarizer
description: Summarize staged git changes using Azure OpenAI or OpenAI-compatible APIs such as LiteLLM, with GPT-4, GPT-5, and GPT-6 support

enumDescriptions: OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions API, such as LiteLLM
aicommitsummarizer.provider.description: API provider. Select openaiCompatible for GPT-6 through LiteLLM.

aicommitsummarizer.endpoint.description: API base URL for the selected provider: your Azure OpenAI resource URL or OpenAI-compatible/LiteLLM base URL. For compatible APIs /chat/completions is appended; include /v1 only if required.

aicommitsummarizer.model.description: Azure deployment name or exact OpenAI-compatible/LiteLLM model alias, depending on the selected provider.

aicommitsummarizer.openaiCompatibleEndpo.deprecationMessage: Migrated to aicommitsummarizer.endpoint. Use the shared endpoint setting.
aicommitsummarizer.openaiCompatibleEndpo.description: OpenAI-compatible API base URL (e.g. http://localhost:4000 or https://your-litellm.example.com/v1). /chat/completions is appended; include /v1 only if your proxy requires it.

aicommitsummarizer.openaiCompatibleModel.deprecationMessage: Migrated to aicommitsummarizer.model. Use the shared model setting.
aicommitsummarizer.openaiCompatibleModel.description: Exact model name or alias configured in LiteLLM, including the desired GPT-6 version. Sent as the model field in the request.

aicommitsummarizer.azureEndpoint.deprecationMessage: Migrated to aicommitsummarizer.endpoint. Use the shared endpoint setting.

aicommitsummarizer.azureDeployment.deprecationMessage: Migrated to aicommitsummarizer.model. Use the shared model setting.
aicommitsummarizer.azureDeployment.description: Azure OpenAI deployment name (e.g. gpt-41-nano or gpt-5-nano)

aicommitsummarizer.userPrompt.default: Summarize these staged changes for a concise commit message. Keep the message short, max 200 characters and in a single line of text:

aicommitsummarizer.gptVersion.description: GPT family used to select request parameters. GPT6 requires the openaiCompatible provider; choose the exact version with model.
